titulo.alumno: Asking for a work instruction to be repeated

intro: In this lesson you will practice asking for a work instruction to be repeated.

frases.estudio: Μπορείτε να επαναλάβετε την οδηγία; Δεν κατάλαβα ποιο αρχείο χρειάζεστε.
frases.alumno: Can you repeat the instruction? I didn't understand which file you need.

frases.estudio: Το μάθημα αρχίζει στις εννέα και τελειώνει στις δύο κάθε Τρίτη.
frases.alumno: The class starts at nine and ends at two every Tuesday.

frases.estudio: Σας αφήνω μήνυμα: το τηλέφωνό μου είναι 210 555 0180.
frases.alumno: I'm leaving you a message: my phone number is 210 555 0180.

texto: Take the hours and tasks from the timetable; when an instruction is not clear, ask for it to be repeated.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the message and note the timetable, the task or the contact detail.
